body: Illustrate {{dish}} as a mouthwatering food diagram. Place the finished bowl at the bottom and separate its main ingredients into tidy floating layers above it, with steam connecting the composition. Add concise labels and quantities from this supplied recipe: {{ingredients}}, using thin leader lines. Use warm directional light, realistic food textures and a clean background with ample margins.
